resources.string: The current app preview finds nearby Bluetooth devices that are broadcasting. Other NIKNOLIG features are still in development.
An interactive preview of possible assistance. Choose an example to view a prepared scenario.
Choose a topic. These texts are prepared in advance and are not generated by AI.
Example: First define the goal. Then note the information and materials needed. Finally, decide for yourself what the next step should be.

Example: Find the instructions for the exact model and follow the manufacturer's safety information. This app does not read or control devices. Work on electrical systems must be done by a qualified electrician.
Example: Set the destination, time window, and materials needed. Check the details yourself and coordinate changes with everyone involved.
Example: Write down tasks, order them by your own priorities, and check off completed items. This preview does not store a personal list.
Honest preview: There is no AI generation, device connection, machine control, or automatic change to safety rules. These are general sample texts, not professional or electrical instructions.
